apps.what_it_does: Enterprise CRM platform for sales, service and marketing teams.
apps.auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 via External Client App (recommended); new Connected Apps restricted since Spring '26 (need Salesforce Support). Specific flows (web server, JWT bearer, client credentials) are listed in a Salesforce Help article not opened here, so JWT is not listed as verified.
apps.access_notes: Free Developer Edition org for testing and development (signup at developer.salesforce.com/signup); user profile needs 'API Enabled' permission. Hosted MCP (GA Apr 2026) is stated for Enterprise Edition and above; Developer Edition support for MCP unconfirmed.
apps.api_notes: REST API and SOAP API developer guides confirmed; Bulk/Metadata/GraphQL APIs exist per wider docs but not opened in this pass.

apps.what_it_does: CRM with marketing, sales, service and content hubs.
apps.auth_notes: OAuth for multi-account (marketplace or private, up to 10 installs); static auth / private-app access token (Bearer) for a single account; developer API key (hapikey) only for some app-level features. Private app tokens need a super admin.
apps.access_notes: Private app tokens work on Free and Starter accounts (100 calls/10s, 250k/day). Developer test accounts are free (90-day enterprise trial features, renewable).
apps.api_notes: CRM objects, associations, marketing, CMS, etc.; app config via HubSpot CLI and app-hsmeta.json on new developer platform.

apps.what_it_does: Pipeline-focused sales CRM for small and mid-size teams.
apps.auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 recommended for all public apps (access_token in Authorization header); personal API token also exists (docs page 'How to find the API token' linked but not opened).
apps.access_notes: Developer sandbox account requested via form on developers.pipedrive.com, no approval step mentioned; docs do not explicitly state it is free. Sandbox deleted if no app created within 45 days or not published/live within 6 months; a community thread reports sandbox closures and a paywall.
apps.api_notes: Public REST API (v1/v2) covering deals, persons, organizations, activities etc.; breadth inferred, reference not opened in detail.

apps.what_it_does: Flexible, data-driven CRM with custom objects and lists.
apps.auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 for multi-workspace apps; workspace API key (scoped access token) from app developer settings for single workspace. Sent as Bearer (Basic also supported).
apps.access_notes: Developer page has 'Start for free'; auth docs list no plan requirement. Free-plan API eligibility not explicitly confirmed (pricing page not opened).
apps.api_notes: REST API with read/write on objects, records, lists plus webhooks; breadth estimate not verified against full reference.

apps.what_it_does: Open-source CRM, self-hostable or cloud, with custom data model.
apps.auth_notes: API key created under Settings > Developers > API, sent as Bearer; can be role-scoped. OAuth available for external apps acting on behalf of users.
apps.access_notes: Open-source core free to self-host; cloud has free trial without credit card (length not stated).
apps.api_notes: Core API (record CRUD) and Metadata API (schema) in both REST and GraphQL; 100 req/min, batches of 60. Cloud base https://api.twenty.com/.

apps.what_it_does: Customizable work-management and collaboration platform with app builder.
apps.auth_notes: OAuth2 server-side, client-side, username/password and app-authentication flows; requires registering an API key (client_id/secret) in account settings.
apps.access_notes: FAQ: free and paid accounts get full API access at same base rate limits. Free plan up to 5 users but limited to 100 items per org. Some destructive ops need raised trust level via support.
apps.api_notes: REST API across apps, items, workspaces, tasks, files, comments etc.

apps.what_it_does: Full-featured CRM for sales automation, pipelines and customer management.
apps.auth_notes: OAuth 2.0; register client at api-console.zoho.com (server-based, client-based, self client, mobile). Access tokens 1h, refresh tokens until revoked. Multi-datacenter domains.
apps.access_notes: API limits doc lists Free edition with 5,000 credits/24h; trial editions get same limits as paid equivalents. Feature list per edition not opened, so Free API access is implied rather than stated.
apps.api_notes: V8 REST APIs over modules, records, metadata, bulk, notifications; credit-based limits per edition.

apps.what_it_does: Sales CRM with built-in calling, email and SMS for inside sales.
apps.auth_notes: API keys sent via HTTP Basic (key as username); creating keys needs the 'Manage own API keys' role permission. OAuth 2.0 apps (client id/secret + redirect URI) for multi-user integrations.
apps.access_notes: Any user with the role permission can create API keys in Settings; developer docs do not state plan gating. Close sells paid plans with a free trial; trial API access is inferred, not stated in docs.
apps.api_notes: ~40 resource groups: leads, contacts, opportunities, activities, sequences, webhooks, users, groups, scheduling links, etc.
apps.round2_change: Fully researched from official docs (was entirely unknown): API key/OAuth2, broad REST, official MCP at mcp.close.com.

apps.what_it_does: CRM built for Google Workspace users.
apps.auth_notes: Headers X-PW-AccessToken (API key), X-PW-Application: developer_api, X-PW-UserEmail. OAuth 2.0 section exists in developer docs for partner apps; its registration/approval process was not opened.
apps.access_notes: Copper support states the API is available on the trial, Professional and Business plans (not on lower tiers).
apps.api_notes: ~14 resource areas: account/users, leads, people, companies, opportunities, projects, tasks, activities, tags, custom fields, related items, files, webhooks.
apps.round2_change: Fully researched (was unknown): API-key headers, API on trial/Professional/Business, community MCP only.

apps.what_it_does: Deal and relationship management platform for capital markets firms.
apps.auth_notes: User generates API key in Profile after admin grants 'API' capability; key + client id exchanged at /api/rest/v1/oauth/token via client_credentials grant with scopes (data, user_management, publish, ri_import, backup).
apps.access_notes: Only DealCloud (Intapp) customer tenants exist; admin must grant API permission. No free/trial signup found - enterprise sales-led product.
apps.api_notes: Data and Schema APIs (generic over all configured objects/entries), User Management, Publications, Relationship Intelligence import, Site Backup; Python and C# SDKs.
apps.human_needed: obtain a DealCloud tenant via Intapp sales/partnership and have admin grant API permission
apps.round2_change: Fully researched (was unknown): OAuth2 client-credentials with API key, official OAuth MCP, but blocked by need for an enterprise tenant.

apps.what_it_does: Customer service platform for ticketing, help center, messaging and voice support.
apps.auth_notes: OAuth access tokens (Bearer) are recommended; authorization code flow (PKCE for public clients) and client credentials flow. API tokens (Basic email/token:key) are being retired: new accounts created on or after July 28, 2026 cannot create or use API tokens, existing accounts cannot create new ones after Oct 27, 2026, and all are deactivated April 30, 2027. Apps distributed to multiple customers must use a global OAuth client; regular OAuth/API tokens are not permitted for that.
apps.access_notes: Free 14-day trial. Marketplace developers can get a non-expiring sponsored 'd3v-' Support account (up to 5 agents) via a request form. The trial page does not explicitly state trial API access, though an admin can create OAuth clients in Admin Center.
apps.api_notes: Ticketing (Support), Help Center, Voice, Sell and other REST APIs; OAuth tokens are tied to the single instance where the client was created unless it is a global client.
apps.human_needed: request sponsored d3v- account and submit global OAuth client request via Zendesk Marketplace portal for review

apps.what_it_does: AI-first customer service platform with messenger, inbox, tickets and help center.
apps.auth_notes: Private apps use a workspace Access Token from the Developer Hub (Authorization: Bearer). Public apps accessing other workspaces must use OAuth. Whether public OAuth apps need Intercom review before install was not confirmed (only App Store listing references a publishing process).
apps.access_notes: Free development workspaces via developer signup, unlimited number. Limits: US region only, max 20 users/leads, no outbound email/push, watermarked Messenger, cannot convert to production. Some APIs return 403 'API Plan restricted' depending on plan.
apps.api_notes: Versioned REST API (e.g. 2.11) covering contacts, conversations, tickets, help center, reporting, data events etc.; plus Canvas Kit, webhooks, Fin Agent API.

apps.what_it_does: Freshworks helpdesk for ticketing, knowledge base and omnichannel customer support.
apps.auth_notes: Personal API key (Profile settings) sent via HTTP Basic as apikey:X. Endpoints list OAuth 2.0 scopes (e.g. freshdesk.tickets.view) but the API docs do not document an OAuth flow for third parties.
apps.access_notes: 14-day free trial, no credit card, all features. API docs state trial accounts have a 50 calls/minute limit, confirming trial API access. No ongoing free plan shown.
apps.api_notes: v2 REST: tickets, conversations, contacts, companies, agents, groups, roles, solutions, custom objects, SLA, automations, time entries, etc. Rate limits vary by plan.

apps.what_it_does: Shared inbox and customer operations platform for team email, chat and SMS.
apps.auth_notes: API tokens (admin-only, company-level, with feature/namespace/permission settings) or OAuth; both used as Bearer. Public integrations for all Front customers must use OAuth unless Front grants an exception.
apps.access_notes: Free development account via developer signup, not tied to production. Default dev account allows 2 channels (community post); plan requirement for API tokens not stated.
apps.api_notes: Core API covering conversations, messages, contacts, inboxes, teammates, tags etc.; breadth inferred from docs/token settings, full reference not opened.

apps.what_it_does: B2B customer support platform across Slack, Teams, email and chat.
apps.auth_notes: Admin-created API tokens (Settings > API Tokens, role-scoped) sent as Authorization: Bearer. No OAuth for the REST API documented; the MCP server is OAuth-only.
apps.access_notes: No free plan or self-serve signup; pricing page routes to 'Book a demo' and free trials for prospects are set up by a sales rep. REST API, scoped tokens and webhooks included on Professional, Advanced and Enterprise; sandbox on Enterprise only.
apps.api_notes: ~22 resource groups: accounts, contacts, issues, messages, knowledge base, custom objects, tags, tasks/projects, teams, users, surveys, audit logs, etc.
apps.human_needed: book a demo with Pylon sales to obtain a trial org

apps.what_it_does: Omnichannel help desk with ticketing, live chat, call center and social channels.
apps.auth_notes: API v3 key sent in 'apikey' header; created by admin at Configuration > System > API with per-key permissions. Separate legacy v1 keys. The built-in MCP server supports OAuth 2.1 (PKCE) or a Bearer token, but the REST API is API-key only.
apps.access_notes: 30-day free trial, no credit card. API key count is plan-limited (Starter 1, Team 5, Business 10, Enterprise unlimited). Trial API access not explicitly stated.
apps.api_notes: API v3 (OpenAPI) per official generated Python SDK: 35+ API groups (agents, calls, contacts, companies, tickets, tags, departments, devices, grid, SLAs, subscriptions...) with roughly 200+ endpoints; legacy v1 has 12 groups/45 endpoints.
apps.round2_change: api_breadth set to broad from the official v3 OpenAPI-generated SDK (35+ groups, ~200+ endpoints); other fields unchanged.

apps.what_it_does: API-first customer support platform for B2B and technical teams.
apps.auth_notes: Machine-user API key sent as 'Authorization: Bearer plainApiKey_...', created in Settings > Machine users & agents with selectable permissions; OAuth apps for acting as workspace users.
apps.access_notes: Any workspace admin can create machine users/keys; docs state no plan gating. Plain is a paid product; self-serve signup with trial assumed, not confirmed in fetched docs.
apps.api_notes: Single GraphQL API covering customers, threads, companies, tenants, labels, tiers, timeline, webhooks, help center; TypeScript SDK.
apps.round2_change: Fully researched (was unknown): GraphQL API with machine-user Bearer key, official OAuth-only MCP.

apps.what_it_does: Shared inbox, help center and live chat for customer support.
apps.auth_notes: Inbox API 2.0 uses OAuth 2.0: authorization code (third-party apps) or client credentials (own account); tokens expire after 2 days. Docs API uses a separate API key.
apps.access_notes: API access on Standard, Plus and Pro plans (Reports endpoints need Plus/Pro); free trial available. Free plan API access not stated.
apps.api_notes: Conversations, threads, customers (+ sub-resources), inboxes, reports, users, teams, tags, workflows, webhooks, properties; plus Docs API.
apps.round2_change: Fully researched (was unknown): OAuth2 REST API, official MCP (read-only for new connections).

apps.what_it_does: Ecommerce-focused helpdesk for Shopify and online stores.
apps.auth_notes: Private apps: account email as Basic username + API key (Settings > You > REST API) as password. Public apps: OAuth2; listing approval process not confirmed.
apps.access_notes: 7-day free trial without credit card (third-party source); API credentials are per-user in Settings. Trial API access not stated by Gorgias docs.
apps.api_notes: REST API v1.1: tickets, messages, customers, users, teams, tags, macros, rules, views, integrations, satisfaction surveys, events, etc.
apps.round2_change: Fully researched (was unknown): API key Basic / OAuth2, official MCP in open beta (May 2026, all plans); endpoint URL not confirmed.

apps.what_it_does: People-centered customer service platform for consumer brands.
apps.auth_notes: Token-based Basic auth: agent email as username, API token (Settings > App Developer Tools > API token, requires 'API User' role) as password. Per-org base URL https://{org}.gladly.com; sandbox at {org}.gladly.qa.
apps.access_notes: No free trial or self-serve signup; Gladly offers only 'Book a Demo'/contact sales. Credentials exist only inside a customer org.
apps.api_notes: ~21 REST groups: agents, answers, conversations, customers, communications, tasks, teams, inboxes, reports, export, topics, webhooks, etc.; plus Lookup API.
apps.main_blocker: sales contact required for an account
apps.human_needed: obtain a Gladly customer or sandbox org through sales/partnership
apps.round2_change: Fully researched (was unknown): documented Basic-auth REST API but sales-only access makes it blocked; MCP only via third-party (StackOne).

apps.what_it_does: Team chat with channels, DMs, apps and workflow automation.
apps.auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 (v2) issues user tokens and bot tokens; app-level tokens also exist; request signing verifies inbound Slack requests. Official MCP uses confidential OAuth with user-token scopes.
apps.access_notes: Anyone can create an app; Slack Developer Program gives free Enterprise-style developer sandboxes with no payment method for a basic sandbox. Since 2025-05-29, commercially distributed non-Marketplace apps get conversations.history/replies cut to Tier 1 (1 req/min, 15 objects); internal and Marketplace apps keep normal limits.
apps.api_notes: Web API with hundreds of methods (chat, conversations, users, files, reactions, etc.) plus Events API, Socket Mode and webhooks.
apps.main_blocker: Marketplace approval needed for full rate limits on distributed apps
apps.human_needed: submit app to Slack Marketplace review for production-grade history/replies limits

apps.what_it_does: Programmable SMS, voice, WhatsApp, email and verification APIs.
apps.auth_notes: HTTP Basic auth: API key SID + secret (recommended) or Account SID + Auth Token where the reference requires it.
apps.access_notes: Free trial without credit card; per-product free units (e.g. 100 SMS, 75 voice minutes); 30-day expiry; only up to 5 verified recipients, sign-up country only, template-only message bodies.
apps.api_notes: Large REST surface (Twilio cites 1,800+ APIs) across Messaging, Voice, Verify, Lookup, Conversations, SendGrid, etc.; public OpenAPI specs.

apps.what_it_does: Zoho's team chat with channels, bots, meetings and automation.
apps.auth_notes: Zoho OAuth 2.0: register client at api-console.zoho.com, authorization code flow, 'Zoho-oauthtoken' header, 1-hour access tokens with refresh; multi-data-center accounts.zoho.{dc} domains; scopes like ZohoCliq.Channels.READ.
apps.access_notes: Free plan exists and lists developer-platform quotas (bots, functions, internal apps); OAuth client registration is self-serve. Explicit statement that REST API is on Free not found.
apps.api_notes: REST API v3 (current; v2 still supported): chats, messages, threads, channels, reminders, attachments, bots, slash commands, functions, datastores, etc.

apps.what_it_does: ByteDance collaboration suite: chat, docs, calendar, base and approvals.
apps.auth_notes: Custom apps exchange app_id + app_secret for tenant_access_token (2h) via /open-apis/auth/v3/tenant_access_token/internal; user_access_token via OAuth 2.0 user consent; app_access_token for store apps.
apps.access_notes: Apps created self-serve in Developer Console (open.larksuite.com/app). Some scopes are no-review; others need a version submitted and tenant-admin approval; test enterprises allow scopes without review. Multi-tenant store apps need Lark platform listing review (ISV qualification). Free Lark plan availability not directly verified (search budget exhausted).
apps.api_notes: Open Platform server APIs across IM, docs/drive, calendar, base, approval, contacts, etc.
apps.main_blocker: store-app listing review / tenant admin approval for scopes
apps.human_needed: tenant admin approves scopes; ISV qualification for marketplace distribution

apps.what_it_does: Team chat by CAKE.com with channels, DMs and calls.
apps.auth_notes: API-keys addon generates per-user API keys (Swagger 'Authorize'); custom apps in Workspace settings yield App key + user/bot tokens (sent as 'token' and 'x-app-token' headers to the MCP). OAuth for third-party apps not confirmed.
apps.access_notes: API keys addon 'available on all plans' for owners, admins and members; MCP 'available to all Pumble users'. Existence of free plan not directly fetched.
apps.api_notes: API-keys addon covers send/reply/delete messages, reactions, create channels, list channels/messages; 1,000 req/min per user. Docs at pumble-api-keys.addons.marketplace.cake.com/api-docs/.

apps.what_it_does: Community chat platform with servers, channels, voice and bots.
apps.auth_notes: Bot token generated when adding a bot user in the Developer Portal; OAuth2 user tokens (Bearer) for acting on behalf of users and bot install via 'bot' scope. Some OAuth scopes are approved-partner only.
apps.access_notes: Apps and bots created free in the Developer Portal. Partner-only scopes (rpc, voice, dm_channels.read etc.) need Discord approval; verified bots have no guild cap.
apps.api_notes: REST API plus WebSocket Gateway: guilds, channels, messages, members, roles, webhooks, interactions/commands, etc.
apps.round2_change: Auth/access now backed by official docs.discord.com pages (partner-gated scopes noted); confidence raised to high.

apps.what_it_does: Cloud messaging app with an HTTP Bot API for bots and channels.
apps.auth_notes: Unique token from @BotFather, embedded in URL: https://api.telegram.org/bot<token>/METHOD_NAME. Separate MTProto user API exists (not used for toolkit).
apps.access_notes: Any Telegram user can create a bot via BotFather for free.
apps.api_notes: HTTP Bot API with ~200 methods: messages, media, chats, stickers, inline mode, payments, games, webhooks/getUpdates.
apps.round2_change: Official core.telegram.org Bot API page now fetched as evidence; confidence raised to high.

apps.what_it_does: Meta's Cloud API for business messaging on WhatsApp.
apps.auth_notes: Graph API access token (temporary or System User) with whatsapp_business_messaging/management permissions plus Phone Number ID / WABA ID; Facebook Login for Business (OAuth) for tech providers and the official MCP.
apps.access_notes: Adding WhatsApp to a Meta app creates a free test WABA and test number (up to 5 recipients). Production needs a real number and Meta Business account; messages from real numbers are billed; payment method and Business Verification are prerequisites per Meta.
apps.api_notes: Cloud API (messages, media, templates, phone numbers, webhooks) and Business Management API on Graph API.
apps.main_blocker: Meta business verification / app review for production
apps.human_needed: complete Meta business verification, add payment method, pass app review for multi-tenant use
apps.round2_change: Access now backed by official get-started page (free test number); MCP URL switched to Meta's official doc page (dev/test only).

apps.what_it_does: Cloud phone system for sales and support teams.
apps.auth_notes: Customers: Basic auth with api_id:api_token generated in Dashboard > Integrations > API keys. Technology Partners: OAuth 2.0 (admin consent, non-expiring Bearer token).
apps.access_notes: Requires an Aircall account to generate API keys; OAuth client credentials only after Tech Partner program approval (developer account initially a 4-month trial). Customer free trial availability not verified.
apps.api_notes: Users, teams, calls, contacts, numbers, tags, webhooks, messages/WhatsApp, conversation intelligence, analytics; 120 req/min per company.
apps.human_needed: apply to Aircall Tech Partner program; obtain Aircall account

apps.what_it_does: Communications APIs for SMS, voice, video, messaging and verification.
apps.auth_notes: API key + secret (Basic auth / params) for many APIs; JWT signed with Application ID private key required for Voice/Messages and webhooks; signed messages supported.
apps.access_notes: Sign-up gives API key/secret and free credit; pay-per-request top-ups afterwards.
apps.api_notes: Messages, SMS, Voice, Verify, Video, Number Insight, Account, Numbers etc.; OpenAPI specs at developer.vonage.com/api.

apps.what_it_does: Google's search, display and video advertising platform.
apps.auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 (user flow or service account) via a Google Cloud project with the Google Ads API enabled. Developer tokens were sunset on 2026-09-09; existing tokens are ignored and access level is now tied to the Cloud project. Manager (MCC) account only needed to manage multiple accounts; login-customer-id header for manager access.
apps.access_notes: Enabling the API gives Test access (test accounts only, 15k ops/day). Explorer access (production accounts, 2,880 ops/day; no account creation/linking, user mgmt, Keyword/Reach planning, billing) is applied for in Cloud Console and usually auto-approved. Basic (15k ops/day) needs brand verification of the Cloud project; reviewed within minutes. Standard (unlimited) needs a manual audit (~10 business days), may require demo access and Required Minimum Functionality. Docs warn free-trial or suspended billing accounts may be rejected for Explorer/Basic.
apps.api_notes: Google Ads API (gRPC with REST interface): campaigns, ad groups, ads, assets, bidding, reporting via GAQL Search/SearchStream, keyword/reach planning, conversions, audiences.
apps.human_needed: complete brand verification / apply for Basic or Standard access on the Cloud project; OAuth consent verification for the adwords scope

apps.what_it_does: Facebook and Instagram ad campaign management and reporting via Marketing API.
apps.auth_notes: Facebook Login OAuth dialog requesting ads_management / ads_read; access tokens (user or system user tokens from Business Manager) passed to the Graph-based Marketing API.
apps.access_notes: Business apps get Standard access by default: usable on own/granted ad accounts against production data, but heavy dev-only rate limits and some calls unavailable. Managing other people's ad accounts requires Advanced Access to ads_read/ads_management via App Review; business verification required for sensitive data. Advanced access is kept only with >=1,500 Marketing API calls in 15 days and <15% error rate.
apps.api_notes: Marketing API on Graph API: campaigns, ad sets, ads, creatives, insights, audiences, catalogs, Business Manager, Conversions API.
apps.human_needed: pass App Review for ads_management/ads_read Advanced Access and complete business verification

apps.what_it_does: LinkedIn B2B advertising campaigns, targeting and analytics via Advertising API.
apps.auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 authorization code (3-legged) flow; access tokens last 60 days; programmatic refresh tokens only for a limited set of partners, otherwise re-authorize. Scopes like rw_ads require specific ad account roles.
apps.access_notes: Requires a LinkedIn Page and developer app, then applying for the Advertising API under the app's Products tab with an access form (use case must be supported). Development tier: unlimited reads, create 1 test ad account, edit up to 5 ad accounts. Standard tier requested via Developer Support ticket; LinkedIn reviews at its discretion and may decline. No approval timeline documented.
apps.api_notes: Versioned Marketing (LMS) REST APIs: ad accounts, campaign groups, campaigns, creatives, reporting/analytics, targeting; Matched Audiences, Lead Sync, Conversions APIs gated separately.
apps.human_needed: create LinkedIn Page, apply for Advertising API access, request Standard tier via support ticket

apps.what_it_does: All-in-one CRM, funnels and marketing automation platform for agencies.
apps.auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 authorization code grant for Marketplace apps (Company/agency vs Location/sub-account tokens; ~24h access tokens, 1-year rotating refresh tokens; no PKCE). Private Integration Tokens (scoped bearer tokens) for internal use. Legacy API keys being phased out; API v1 end-of-support 2025-12-31.
apps.access_notes: API access included on Starter ($97/mo), Unlimited ($297/mo) and Founder ($497/mo, formerly Agency Pro); some endpoints (create sub-account, SaaS) Founder-only. Marketplace Developer Portal offers sandbox (app test) accounts with trial Enterprise features for up to 6 months; whether developer portal/sandbox is free without a subscription was not confirmed.
apps.api_notes: API v2 (and v3 for some endpoints): contacts, conversations, calendars, opportunities, workflows, payments, sub-accounts etc. Rate limit 100 req/10s burst, 200k/day per app per resource.
apps.human_needed: hold a paid HighLevel plan (or confirm free sandbox via Marketplace developer portal)

apps.what_it_does: Email marketing and audience management platform.
apps.auth_notes: API key (own account) or OAuth 2 access token (third-party installs); both sent via Basic (any username, token as password) or Bearer header. Access limited by user role.
apps.access_notes: Free Mailchimp account can generate API keys; docs say capabilities depend on plan level. Free-plan API access inferred from developer get-started guide, not explicitly stated.
apps.api_notes: Marketing API 3.0: audiences/lists, members, campaigns, automations, templates, reports, ecommerce stores, landing pages, etc.; separate Transactional (Mandrill) API.
apps.round2_change: Fully researched (was unknown): API key/OAuth2 REST; official MCP exists only for docs search, so account-level MCP is community.

apps.what_it_does: Email and SMS marketing automation for ecommerce brands.
apps.auth_notes: Private key (pk_...) in 'Authorization: Klaviyo-API-Key <key>' plus revision header; scoped keys need Owner/Admin/Manager role. OAuth recommended for tech partners/App Marketplace. Public site ID for client endpoints.
apps.access_notes: Account users with Owner/Admin/Manager role create private keys; Klaviyo has a free tier. Free-tier API access not explicitly stated in fetched docs.
apps.api_notes: JSON:API REST: profiles, lists, segments, events, metrics, campaigns, flows, templates, catalogs, coupons, reporting, webhooks, etc.
apps.round2_change: Fully researched (was unknown): private-key/OAuth REST, official remote MCP (OAuth) and local MCP (private key).

apps.what_it_does: All-in-one funnel builder, email marketing and course platform.
apps.auth_notes: Public API key created in Settings > MCP & API keys (max 3, optional expiry); exact header name not confirmed in fetched pages (X-API-Key per common usage). MCP uses separate MCP keys (max 90 days); OAuth planned.
apps.access_notes: Keys are self-created in account settings; systeme.io has a free plan, but plan eligibility for the API is not stated in help articles.
apps.api_notes: Public API covers contacts, tags, custom fields, newsletters/campaigns, funnels, courses, communities, automation rules, webhooks.
apps.round2_change: Fully researched (was unknown): self-created API key, moderate REST API, official MCP with MCP keys.

apps.what_it_does: Visual discovery social network with pins, boards and ads.
apps.auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 user access tokens are the only compliant method (Bearer on API v5).
apps.access_notes: Apps must be approved by Pinterest before getting Trial access (sandbox-only Pins/boards, daily limits). Standard (production) access needs an upgrade request with a demo video of the OAuth flow; community reports multi-week waits.
apps.api_notes: API v5: pins, boards, sections, user account, search, media, ads/campaigns, ad accounts, audiences, catalogs, analytics.
apps.main_blocker: app review for Trial and Standard access
apps.human_needed: submit app for Trial approval, then record demo video and pass Standard access review
apps.round2_change: Fully researched (was unknown): OAuth2 v5 API gated by Trial app approval and Standard review (video demo); 'admin-approval' used for Pinterest platform approval.

apps.what_it_does: Meta's text-based social app; API for publishing and reading posts.
apps.auth_notes: Threads OAuth: authorize at threads.com/oauth/authorize, exchange code at graph.threads.com/oauth/access_token; scopes threads_basic (required), threads_content_publish, threads_read_replies, threads_manage_replies, threads_manage_insights.
apps.access_notes: Free Meta app with the Threads use case works for the developer and added Threads Testers; serving other users requires App Review before publishing the app (business verification may apply).
apps.api_notes: Graph-style API: publishing (containers, carousels), replies management, deletion, location tagging, insights, profiles, publishing limits (250 posts/24h).
apps.human_needed: pass Meta App Review for threads_* permissions
apps.round2_change: Fully researched (was unknown): Threads OAuth2 with tester-mode self-serve, App Review needed for public use, community MCP only.

apps.what_it_does: Twilio's transactional and marketing email delivery service.

Product availability depends on region/account status; geo-restriction list not verified this pass. Official MCP account actions require creating and manually funding an Agentic sub-account.
apps.api_notes: Spot REST + WebSocket API + streams; security types NONE (market data), TRADE, USER_DATA, USER_STREAM; plus margin, futures, wallet product APIs.

apps.human_needed: complete Binance KYC, enable 2FA, deposit funds, create API key with IP restriction

apps.human_needed: Brex admin accepts API agreement and issues token, or request partner OAuth credentials
